candidate_sentence_map.S1: Ambu reported a solid start to Q1 2025/26, although profitability and cash generation declined against an exceptionally strong prior-year quarter.
candidate_sentence_map.S2: Revenue increased to DKK 1,558m from DKK 1,510m, representing 8.6% organic growth and 3.2% reported growth.
candidate_sentence_map.S3: Endoscopy Solutions remained the main growth engine, delivering 14.4% organic growth and accounting for 63% of revenue.
candidate_sentence_map.S4: Within this segment, Urology, ENT, & GI grew 21.0%, primarily supported by continued adoption of the aScope 4 portfolio and strong momentum for aScope 5 Uretero, while Respiratory grew 8.3%, driven by bronchoscopy solutions, aScope 5 Broncho adoption, and the SureSight video laryngoscope launch.
candidate_sentence_map.S5: Anesthesia & Patient Monitoring was essentially flat, with organic growth of -0.1%, reflecting an extraordinarily high comparable revenue base from Q1 2024/25.
candidate_sentence_map.S6: Growth was strongest in North America and Europe, with organic increases of 9.8% and 9.7%, respectively.
candidate_sentence_map.S7: Rest of World declined 1.6% organically because of order fluctuations and high comparable revenue from the previous year.
candidate_sentence_map.S8: Foreign-exchange effects reduced total reported growth by 5.4%.
candidate_sentence_map.S9: EBIT before special items fell to DKK 164m from DKK 243m, and the EBIT margin declined to 10.5% from 16.1%.
candidate_sentence_map.S10: The report attributes the margin pressure to tariff costs and foreign-exchange headwinds; tariff costs exceeded DKK 50m.
candidate_sentence_map.S11: Excluding these external factors, the EBIT margin was 15.2%, indicating continued underlying operating leverage.
candidate_sentence_map.S12: The reported gross margin decreased modestly to 60.8% from 61.3%, while the operating-expense ratio increased to 50.3% from 45.2%, partly because Ambu continued investing in commercial infrastructure and tariff costs were included in operating expenses.
candidate_sentence_map.S13: Net profit declined to DKK 118m from DKK 183m, while earnings per share fell to DKK 0.44 from DKK 0.68.
candidate_sentence_map.S14: Operating cash flow decreased to DKK 106m from DKK 144m, and free cash flow before acquisitions fell to DKK 13m from DKK 69m.
candidate_sentence_map.S15: Cash flow was negatively affected by lower EBITDA, elevated net working capital, foreign-exchange effects, and tariff costs.
candidate_sentence_map.S16: Net working capital remained elevated at DKK 1,321m, or 22% of revenue, mainly because of higher inventories.
candidate_sentence_map.S17: Ambu introduced the portable SureSight Mobile video laryngoscope and expanded its Recircle recycling programme to include SureSight blades during 2026.
candidate_sentence_map.S18: The company maintained its full-year guidance for 10–13% organic revenue growth, a 12–14% EBIT margin before special items, and cash conversion above 40%, while noting that growth and margins are expected to be higher in the second half than in the first.

evaluation.label: Generally yes
evaluation.justification: The candidate summary adequately covers the core material meaning of K1-K6, K8-K10, representing most HIGH importance criteria. K7 (dividend and treasury share acquisition) and K11 (sustainability milestones) are missing entirely, both MEDIUM/HIGH importance items. The absence of K7 and K11 represents a meaningful gap in financial and sustainability reporting, but the majority of HIGH importance operational and financial results are present, justifying a 'Generally yes' rating.
